title: 星を掬う夜の止まり木
author: 月城 すばる

en.title: The Night Perch for Gathering Stars
en.premise: In a metropolis blinded by dazzling neon lights, the stars have long since vanished from view. But within a quiet cafe, a young astronomer listens to the worries of his guests, guiding them toward a star that resonates with their heart. As the night sky is reflected into the shop through mirrors, visitors rediscover the 'silence' and the 'inner light' they had almost forgotten. A gentle tale of nighttime, scooping up small fragments of happiness like stardust.

zh.title: 掬星之夜的栖木
zh.premise: 在被耀眼霓虹覆盖、再也看不见星空的大都市中，有一家静谧的咖啡店。店主是一位天文青年，他倾听客人的烦恼，并为他们寻找一颗能慰藉心灵的星辰。在镜面将夜空映射至店内的光影中，人们逐渐找回了久违的“静谧”与“自我的光芒”。这是一个在温柔夜晚，掬起如星屑般微小幸福的故事。
